name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 5 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 33 hours starting 2026-07-14, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.08 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
